name: @wadleun2ty/securex
description: Simplify security in JavaScript — simple, fast, secure

scripts.publish:patch: bash .scripts/version.sh patch && git add . && git commit -m "chore(release): v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push && npm publish
scripts.publish:minor: bash .scripts/version.sh minor && git add . && git commit -m "chore(release): v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push && npm publish
scripts.publish:major: bash .scripts/version.sh major && git add . && git commit -m "chore(release): v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push && npm publish
scripts.build: mkdir -p bin && cp -r lib/core bin/ && cp LICENSE bin/LICENSE
